citations.narrative:
The registrant failed to notify APHIS of a change in the operations of the facility. On June 5, 2026, an APHIS Official
arrived at the research facility to conduct a routine unannounced inspection. At the time of inspection, it was determined
that the entire campus ceased operations and no regulated activity was conducted at the research facility since April 1,
2026. The registrant changed its status as a research facility and failed to notify the Deputy Administrator within 10 days
of making the change.
A research facility shall notify the Deputy Administrator in writing of any change in operations affecting its status as a
research facility, within 10 days after making such change. Corrected on June 5, 2026 - Cancellation Letter sent to Deputy
Administrator.

A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 9:30 AM on
6/5/2026. The inspector attempted to contact the registrant by calling the main number on file and the contacts provided.
The APHIS Official knocked on the front door of the facility but the building and parking lot appeared empty. APHIS
personnel spoke with the Director of Compliance for the main campus facility who stated the Brecksville, OH location has
shutdown and there was no responsible adult available to conduct the inspection. Failure to provide access to the facility,
animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is
serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
